global.concept_prompt:
Ultra-realistic, cinematic, faceless short-form video that takes the viewer on a single continuous first-person journey to and through the door of a modest, mysterious structure in a dramatic remote place, and then down into a hidden, secret, luxurious living space concealed below it.

The video must be composed for a vertical 9:16 frame and must always remain upright, never sideways or horizontal.

The video ALWAYS follows the same fixed five-beat format — only the setting, the structure, and the hidden interior change between episodes:
1. FIRST-PERSON POV sprinting toward the structure's door AND shoving it open in one CONTINUOUS motion — like fleeing for your life. The video opens already in full-tilt motion: the lone traveler is sprinting flat out through a dramatic remote setting on a NON-LINEAR weaving path (cutting around rocks, trees, terrain — NOT a straight line) toward the entrance door. The door is at a MEDIUM distance ahead in K0 (clearly visible as a door, roughly 10–15 metres away) — close enough that the sprint reaches and opens it within a single 5-second clip, NOT a tiny dot on the horizon. As the runner reaches the door, his hand SLAMS it open INWARD in one fast motion — the door swings open inward without slowing his stride — and he BARGES THROUGH into the structure's interior. The door opening is NOT a separate slow beat; it happens FAST and CONTINUOUSLY inside the sprint. By the end of scene 1 (K1) the runner is JUST INSIDE the doorway, mid-stride, with the door OPEN behind him and the structure's interior threshold visible ahead.
2. FIRST-PERSON POV continuing purposefully through the structure's interior threshold/foyer toward the top of a normal straight step staircase descending into warm light below — still hurrying, purposeful brisk pace, NOT yet calm. By the end of scene 2 (K2) the runner is AT the top of the staircase, looking DOWN it.
3. FIRST-PERSON POV continuously descending that short straight step staircase from top to bottom — the camera STAYS IN POV start-to-end, NEVER lifts to a third-person view mid-stairs, NEVER skips ahead, NEVER time-jumps. The pace can ease slightly here as he reaches safety. The staircase is STRUCTURALLY ATTACHED — real treads on real stringers attached to side walls and floor; NEVER floating steps, NEVER unsupported. The stairwell is FULLY ENCLOSED (rock, concrete, wood, stone) with NO outdoor windows or daylight from outside. Any handrail is mounted on the SIDE WALL — never in the middle/centerline of the staircase, never intersecting the traveler's body.
4. OFF-POV (third-person) first reveal of the hidden luxurious interior. The clip starts already in off-POV: the camera is positioned ACROSS the room, opposite the staircase entrance, looking back toward the bottom of the stairs where the traveler has just emerged. Over the clip the camera slowly TRACKS LATERALLY (a smooth horizontal dolly) from one side of the room to the other while the lone traveler — seen only from behind or in profile, face NEVER shown — walks calmly in ONE CONSISTENT DIRECTION across the room (e.g. from the staircase area toward the next room's archway), unbothered, like he lives here. He does NOT turn around, reverse direction, change clothing, change body, or melt — his clothing, silhouette, gait, and direction are LOCKED across the clip.
5. The traveler walks toward and through an open archway or doorway into ANOTHER luxurious room of the hidden residence — same materials, lighting palette, and continuity as room 1 (physically consistent residence) — and the camera follows him from behind (still off-POV, face never shown) in one smooth continuous house-tour move. His clothing, body, silhouette, and gait are IDENTICAL to scene 4 — he does not change appearance, reverse, or melt.

CAMERA: Scenes 1–3 are real FIRST-PERSON POV — a body-cam or chest-mounted GoPro on the traveler. Scene 1 is EXTREME body-cam shake (a panicked sprint plus the door slammed open in stride). Scene 2 is a hurried brisk walk through the interior threshold (reduced bob, still handheld). Scene 3 is step-by-step bob descending. The traveler's torso, legs, reflection, and face are NEVER visible in POV — EXCEPTION in scene 1: his arms and hands swing in and out of the BOTTOM of the frame as he pumps them while sprinting (and one hand briefly slams the door open at the end of the clip). Scenes 4–5 are calm off-POV (third-person) shots in which the traveler is seen only from behind or in profile — his face is NEVER shown. This is a faceless channel.

RUNNING & MOVEMENT MUST LOOK REAL — highest priority and the channel's biggest current weakness. In scene 1 the camera must JOLT EXTREMELY DOWN-UP AND side-to-side with EACH footfall in a FAST sprint cadence (about 3–4 strides per second — a flat-out sprint, NOT a jog), the frame ROTATES 8–15 degrees alternately left and right per stride before recentering, the horizon dips, rises, and tilts violently, motion blur appears at the frame edges from speed, panicked panting breath audible. The runner's ARMS and HANDS swing in and out of the BOTTOM of the frame as he pumps them. The runner's head turns to SCAN the surroundings and GLANCES OVER THE SHOULDER BACKWARDS as if checking for pursuit — the camera is NOT always pointed at the destination door, and the door enters and exits the frame as the runner weaves. It must read as REAL body-cam footage from a foot pursuit on a panicked human being who is FLEEING, NEVER a smooth tracking shot, dolly, gimbal, Steadicam, gliding camera, floating camera, weightless camera, or skating motion. NEVER feet that slide forward without a real running gait.

THE DESCENT IS ALWAYS A NORMAL STRAIGHT STEP STAIRCASE going DOWN — structurally attached, never floating. It is NEVER a ladder, vertical ladder, ladder rungs, spiral staircase, circular or helical staircase, ship's ladder, rope ladder, trapdoor with a ladder, or stairs going up. The traveler only ever descends.

The door must be a real, solid, three-dimensional object with thickness, hinges, and hardware. It opens INWARD (into the structure), FAST, in one motion as the runner shoves it open mid-stride WITHIN scene 1. It NEVER opens outward toward the viewer, NEVER opens slowly or ceremoniously, NEVER vanishes, dissolves, fades, or dematerializes, and is NEVER its own slow separate beat in scene 2.

INTERIOR CONSISTENCY (scenes 4 and 5) — critical: across K3, K4, and K5 the hidden interior must be PERFECTLY CONSISTENT. Same walls, ceiling, floor, furniture, lighting, palette, and materials in every frame. NO floating elements, NO shape-shifting, NO morphing geometry, NO furniture appearing or disappearing. The lone traveler has IDENTICAL clothing, body, hair/hood, height, and silhouette in every interior frame — he MUST NOT change appearance, change clothes, or melt. He walks in ONE consistent direction per clip — he does NOT turn around, reverse direction mid-walk, or walk backwards.

The payoff, every episode, is the hidden, secret, LUXURIOUS, fully-furnished LIVING space below the structure (a modern underground apartment with a glass wall onto the dark sea, a warm library-lounge with a fireplace, a spa retreat with a quiet pool, a mid-century lounge, a panoramic cliff-cut bedroom, etc.). The hidden space is concealed below ground or within the rock beneath the structure; the staircase down explains the hidden volume. The interior must be physically consistent with the exterior and the descent.

Everything must look like something a real, wealthy, eccentric person could genuinely have built and could genuinely own — human-scale, physically plausible, photoreal. No heavy machinery, no impossible architecture, no fantasy, no sci-fi, no magic, no supernatural.

The audio is ONLY real, natural, diegetic sound that matches exactly what is on screen — wind, sea, rain, the runner's hard footfalls on the SPECIFIC ground surface, panting breath, the door SLAMMING open inward, footsteps walking on the SPECIFIC interior threshold surface, footsteps descending the SPECIFIC staircase material, the quiet room tone of the hidden interior. NEVER any music, soundtrack, score, or dramatic sound design. Every kling_prompt must explicitly state 'no music' AND name the SPECIFIC surface material for footsteps in that scene (e.g. 'footsteps on wet rocks', 'footsteps on a wooden plank floor', 'footsteps on creaking timber stairs', 'footsteps on a hardwood floor') — vague or missing surface naming causes missing or wrong step sounds.

No frame may ever contain words, numbers, subtitles, captions, logos, watermarks, or UI. This channel uses NO on-screen text of any kind.

global.style_notes: Photorealistic live-action documentary realism — the look of real on-location footage, not a stylized render. Strict vertical 9:16, always upright. The piece is one continuous journey in a fixed five-beat format: POV sprint to a door + shove it open inward in one continuous motion, POV walk through the interior threshold to the top of a straight step staircase going down, POV continuously descend the staircase, OFF-POV slow lateral tracking across the hidden interior while a faceless figure walks calmly in one direction, and OFF-POV smooth follow into another luxurious room. Scenes 1-3 are raw first-person POV like body-cam/GoPro footage (scene 1 is EXTREME shake — body-cam from a foot pursuit, with arms in the lower frame and the door entering/exiting between strides; scene 2 is a hurried brisk walk; scene 3 is step-by-step descent bob). Scenes 4-5 are calm off-POV third-person shots — the traveler is seen only from behind or in profile, face never shown, clothing/body LOCKED across both scenes, walking in one consistent forward direction. The setting is a dramatic, remote, atmospheric natural place (storm-lashed coast, fog-drowned forest, cliff edge, snowy ridge, desert canyon) with moody natural light, real weather, and the modest structure whose humble exterior hides a luxurious living space below. The descent is always a normal short straight step staircase structurally attached to side walls and floor — never a ladder, never floating; the stairwell is fully enclosed with no outdoor window. Audio is natural diegetic sound only, never music. EVERY kling_prompt names the specific surface material for footsteps (e.g. wet rocks, wooden plank floor, creaking timber stairs, hardwood floor). No on-screen text ever. Most episodes look similar — only the setting, structure, and hidden interior change.

By the END of this scene (K1) the runner is JUST INSIDE the doorway, mid-stride, with the door OPEN behind him and the structure's interior threshold visible ahead. NOT 'reaching for the handle', NOT 'arrived at the door' — already INSIDE with the door open.
  CRITICAL OVERRIDE (more important than the motion-grammar block below): for scene 1, IGNORE any 'tracking shot' or smooth-motion grammar. DO NOT write 'tracking shot', 'forward tracking shot', 'dolly', 'gimbal', 'Steadicam', 'smooth tracking', 'gliding camera', 'floating', 'weightless', 'skating', 'jogging', 'straight line', 'directly toward', 'slow door opening', or any smooth-motion language. He is STILL HURRYING — purposeful brisk pace, NOT calm, NOT yet at ease — the panic of scene 1 hasn't fully released. - SCENE 3 — POV CONTINUOUS DESCENT (behavior 'exploration').
